people.name: Bezalel
people.line: Skilled craftsman who built the tabernacle

people.name: Hur
people.line: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.

people.name: Uri
people.line: Father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman

translations.web: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
translations.bsb: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
translations.kjv: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
translations.asv: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezalel.
